buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Kindly Note that Rates quoted by only those vendors will be considered who will submit the declaration on their letter head that * They have gone through all the terms and conditions and are accepted to them. * They will pull policy dockets from the racks, segregate the documents from the dockets, then rearrange t he dockets in the shelves as per instructions of LIC * Put the segregated papers & Dockets in separate bags as per scope of work * All necessary materials viz., ladders, gloves, masks, cleaning liquid, bags etc will be provided by the ven dor without any extra cost. SCOPE OF WORK AND GENERAL TERMS & CONDITIONS FOR RECORD PULLING & SEGREGATION OF DOCUMENTS FROM THE POLICY DOCKETS 1. This Bid is floated for pulling out of approximately 1.35 Lakh Policy Dockets and 494 incremental batche s with 10 files in each batch from the Racks placed at our RMF Centre & then Separation of Documents fro m the Policy Dockets at our RMF Centre addressed at Mahajan Rice & General Mills Vallah Sabzi Mandi, ne xt to Mahajan Kanda, Mehta Road Amritsar. 2. Vendor is required to take out the policy records from racks as per the list given by us. Excel format list will be provided both in soft – file & hard copy which contains details of policy no, branch no, batch no. of old policy records. 3. Rearranging of balance dockets as per our requirement in racks & revised numbering of the shelves and racks. Creation of vacant racks and their rearrangement as per our instructions. 4. Segregation of docket covers & the papers inside dockets will be done by vendor after thorough verification by L.I.C. official. 5. Papers inside docket shall be packed inside the big bags, Bags will be provided by the vendor only. 6. Empty Dockets shall be packed in bags in bundle of 1000 dockets. Bags will be provided by the vendor only Detailed Job Description for Taking out Dockets from policy racks a. Taking out the lapsed policy records from racks as per the list provided by LIC office.

b. After verification by LIC officials, the docket cover and the papers inside to be segregated & kept separa tely by vendor. c. Dockets Covers in the bundles of 1000 will packed in Bags d. Segregated papers shall be packed separately in the Bags. e. Rearranging of records (dockets) backwards in the space generated in racks f. Renumbering of shelf & racks, rearrangement of vacant racks as per instructions of LIC. g. The successful bidder should produce the names and Id-proofs of the persons who will be engaged for th ese services for issue of temporary entry pass which should be produced on demand. h. All labour charges involved in the above contract job for various activities have to be borne by the bidd er only. Successful bidder should comply all statutory labour laws and regulations. i. The bidder should engage such persons who are adequately literate to read 8 or 9 digit policy nos and ph ysically fit so that they can take out records and renumber the racks after rearrangement. Vendor should d eploy adequate number of persons to complete the job. j. The bidder has to arrange for necessary materials viz., ladders, gloves, masks, cleaning liquid, bags etc f or the work and persons engaged in the job k. Corporation reserves the right to increase or decrease the number of dockets at any time during the cur rency of the contract. Successful Bidder is bound to accept the orders accordingly. Payment then shall be made on the pro rata basis. l. Corporation reserves the right to terminate / cancel the whole or part of the agreement at their sole discr etion. m. Contractor is to fully indemnify the LIC of India against any type of loss/accident caused due to neglige nce of the contractor and he should take all the precaution for smooth execution of work. n. In terms of provisions of Section 33 (3) of the Insurance Act, 1938 as amended by the Insurance Laws (A mendments) ordinance, 2014. Insurance Regulatory Authority of India (IRDAI) is authorized to verify all suc h books of account, register, other documents and data base in the custody of the contractor in respect of service outsourced by the LIC of India. It shall be the duty of the contractor to provide such documents / st atements / information .
